title: 2233. Maximum Product After K Increments

examples.explanation: Increment the first number 5 times. Now nums = [5, 4], with a product of 5 * 4 = 20. It can be shown that 20 is maximum product possible, so we return 20. Note that there may be other ways to increment nums to have the maximum product.

Increment the second number 1 time and increment the fourth number 1 time. Now nums = [6, 4, 3, 3], with a product of 6 * 4 * 3 * 3 = 216. It can be shown that 216 is maximum product possible, so we return 216. Note that there may be other ways to increment nums to have the maximum product.
